output.reason: The PR [ev-56e3b21bf0e2] says that for incoming gRPC or gRPC-Web requests, the metrics now get `grpc` or `grpcweb` as the protocol, and the `code` label holds the gRPC code (for example Unauthenticated) instead of the HTTP status. The proposed statement gets this wrong: nothing in the evidence says metrics endpoints "accept and process" gRPC requests. The kind behavior-change is right, because metrics keep working and only label values change for gRPC traffic. The PR also edits the v2-to-v3 migration guide [ev-ee47bb3f9ef7], so the change is worth reviewing, and nothing says anything fails.

correction.statement: In Traefik 3.0.0, metrics for gRPC and gRPC-Web requests report protocol="grpc"/"grpcweb" and put the gRPC code (e.g. Unauthenticated) in the `code` label instead of the HTTP status. This is a behavior change to review.

consequence.statement: Metrics keep working. For incoming gRPC and gRPC-Web requests, Traefik now sets the protocol label to `grpc` or `grpcweb` and puts the gRPC code (e.g. Unauthenticated) in the `code` label instead of the HTTP status. Queries, dashboards or alerts that read these labels for gRPC traffic will see different values.
consequence.remediation: Check metric queries, dashboards and alerts that filter on the `protocol` or `code` labels for gRPC/gRPC-Web traffic, and update them to use the new protocol values and gRPC code names (see the v2-to-v3 migration guide).
